'''Marc García Renom''' (born 21 March 1988) is an Andorran [[Association football|footballer]] who plays for [[CD Binéfar]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]] as a [[Defender (association football)#Full-back|left-back]].

==Club career==
Born in [[Andorra la Vella]], García all but spent his entire career in the [[Spanish football league system|Spanish lower leagues]]. He started out at [[SE Eivissa-Ibiza B]], representing in quick succession [[UD Fraga]],<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.futbolenaragon.com/?ver=noticia&categoria=4&nid=1983|title=La U.D.Fraga, a consolidarse|trans-title=U.D.Fraga, making a name for themselves|publisher=Fútbol en Aragón|language=es|date=2009|access-date=13 October 2012}}</ref> [[UD Pomar]], [[Atlético Monzón]] and [[UE Vic]].

In June 2013, García signed with [[Segunda División B]] club [[CF Badalona Futur|UE Llagostera]], being immediately loaned to [[Palamós CF]] and then to [[Cerdanyola del Vallès FC]], both from [[Tercera División]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.elperiodic.ad/noticia/33740/marc-garcia-no-cobrava-al-palams-i-signa-pel-cerdanyola|title=Marc Garcia no cobrava al Palamós i signa pel Cerdanyola|trans-title=Marc Garcia was not being paid at Palamós and signs for Cerdanyola|newspaper=[[El Periòdic d'Andorra]]|language=ca|date=29 October 2013|access-date=31 March 2021}}</ref> He returned to Andorra two decades after leaving, with the 34-year-old joining [[UE Engordany]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rtva.ad/esports/futbol/marc-garcia-torna-andorra-despres-22|title=Marc Garcia torna a Andorra després de 22 anys per ajudar l'Engordany a lluitar per anar a Europa|trans-title=Marc Garcia returns to Andorra after 22 years to help Engordany fight to go to Europe|publisher=[[Radio and Television of Andorra]]|first=Sergi|last=Cano|language=ca|date=17 September 2022|access-date=7 July 2026}}</ref>

==International career==
García made his debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] on 29 May 2010, in a 4–0 [[Exhibition game|friendly]] loss against [[Iceland national football team|Iceland]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/miscellaneous/ando-recintlp.html|title=Andorra – Record International Players|publisher=[[RSSSF]]|first1=Sébastien|last1=Duret|first2=Roberto|last2=Mamrud|access-date=3 June 2016}}</ref>

==Personal life==
While still working as a footballer, García was a [[Physical therapy|physiotherapy]] student at EU Gimbernat.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/i/flow/login?redirect_after_login=%2FMarcGarcia_21|title=|trans-title=|publisher=[[Twitter]]|language=es|date=|access-date=3 January 2024}}</ref>
